scope: Actual fifteen generated whole worlds; all generated body FloorPlans and roof regions; 151 fixed probes per world; five primary-seed native Simulation exports/imports at tick 0. No simulation steps, 24-tick continuation, npm suite, benchmark, browser, renderer, GPU, normal walking or pixel evidence.
canonicalDefinition: Sort object keys recursively; preserve array order and finite JS number values; JSON.stringify scalar encoding; no rounding. Full-world and native-save SHA are original UTF-8 bytes, with no pretty-printing or trailing newline.

probeSpecification.river: all baseline river points; each segment midpoint with perpendicular offsets -18,0,18 metres
probeSpecification.waterfall: all baseline hydraulic path points and three segment midpoints
probeSpecification.samplingRule: All locations/reference heights are frozen from baseline before candidate runs. Candidate geometry never selects or moves a probe. Grid is absolute and independent of both sources.
